_comment: AR board config. Edit, commit, Netlify redeploys in ~30 seconds. Nothing secret belongs in here.

report._comment: ServiceTitan report 435, 'OD - AR Transactions By Customer'. Customer-level, ServiceTitan's own aging math.
report._parametersNote: Mirrors the checkboxes as set in the ServiceTitan UI. AsOfDate is added by the feed at runtime so the report is never frozen to a stale date.

ar.title: ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE
ar.subtitle: Omaha Drain
ar._worklistNote: The worklist ranks by PAST DUE money, not by total owed. Sorting by total owed puts customers at the top who were invoiced two weeks ago and owe nothing late — a collections person would spend the morning calling people who are not late. 'basis' is which columns count as past due; the default is everything 31 days and older, matching the first gauge. minPastDue is a call-list floor only: it decides who is worth a phone call, and it deliberately does NOT affect the gauges, which measure all receivables.

privacy._note: nameStyle: full | initial | hidden. This screen sits at one desk facing a wall, so full is appropriate. Change to initial if it ever moves somewhere customers can see it.

ar._membershipNote: A $99 recurring charge that failed to bill, appearing as identical balances across hundreds of accounts. These are a billing fix, not collections calls, so they are pulled out of the aging math entirely and shown as one tile. Matching is by exact amount because report 435 carries no membership field — watch the customer count on the tile; if it drifts, the amount list needs updating.

membership.label: Membership Dues
membership.note: Membership dues to clean up. Billing fix, not a collections call.

ar._gaugeNote: Cumulative, not per-bucket: 'over 60' includes everything 61 days and older. Each gauge carries its own thresholds, because the same percentage means different things at different ages — 25% of receivables sitting past 30 days is normal trade credit, while 25% sitting past 90 days is money you may never see. Membership dues are excluded from both the top and bottom of every ratio.
ar._bandsNote: Fallback only — used if a gauge above has no bands of its own. At or below goodMax is green, up to warnMax is orange, at or above warnMax is red.

slipping.label: Slipping
slipping.emptyMessage: Nothing slipping. This is the win.

ar._checklistNote: Plain text, edit freely. Shows along the bottom of the screen.
checklist: Work the list top down — biggest PAST DUE first, always
Log every call in ServiceTitan, even the no-answers
Text or email a payment link on any no-answer before moving on
Anything over $2,000: get a payment date on the calendar, not a promise
New name in Slipping? Call it this week, before it turns 90
End of day: mark what you collected and what needs a callback
